title: mintyrasr 入门
text: 比较基因组预测模型时，mintyr 为每个场景准备两张表：参数估计数据（全部记录）和训练集 / 验证集（每个“重复 × 折”一行），所有场景在同一批个体上验证。mintyrasr 接过这两张表，对每一行： 用全部数据拟合模型：方差组分、h2；两性状再加 rg、rp 和 rg = 0 的似然比检验； 用每个训练集重新拟合（方差组分固定、以全数据为初值重估，或完全重估）； 预测验证个体的 GEBV，计算可靠性、预测能力、准确性和回归系数； 按折汇总，每个场景写一个 Excel 工作簿。

title: mintyrasr 入门
code: # 先安装并激活 ASReml-R 4（https://vsni.co.uk/） install.packages("mintyr") pak::pak("tony2015116/mintyrasr")

title: mintyrasr 入门
text: 需要三样东西： 表型：每个个体一行，包括 ID、分组列（场、品系……）、固定效应和性状； ginv：vm() 能用的基因组关系逆矩阵。必须带 attr(ginv, "INVERSE") <- TRUE，否则 vm() 会把它当成 G 本身（mintyrasr 会警告）； 近交系数（可选）：数据框 (id, F)，用于可靠性 1 - PEV / ((1 + F) Va)。GBLUP 常用 F = diag(G) - 1；不提供时 F = 0。
code: library(asreml) library(ASRgenomics) library(mintyr) library(mintyrasr)  pheno <- import_xlsx("pheno.xlsx")             # id, test_herd, hhys, adg, bf, fcr  G    <- G.matrix(M = snp, method = "VanRaden")$G ginv <- G.inverse(G = G, sparseform = TRUE)$Ginv.sparse   # 自带 INVERSE = TRUE inbreeding <- data.frame(id = rownames(G), F = diag(G) - 1)

title: mintyrasr 入门
code: sc <- cv_scenarios(pheno, cols = c("adg", "bf", "fcr"), id = "id",                    group = "test_herd", v = 5, repeats = 5, seed = 2026,                    out_type = "df")      # ASReml-R 需要 data.frame sc

title: mintyrasr 入门
text: 在 scenarios 中加入 "mt_bt"，就是把同一性状在两个群体当作两个性状（G×E）。没有个体同时有两个群体的记录，所以自动用 diag 残差，不算 rp：
code: res <- asr_scenarios(sc, ginv, fixed = ~ hhys, inbreeding = inbreeding,                      dir = "results") # results/st_sp_ginv.xlsx、st_mp_ginv.xlsx、mt_sp_ginv.xlsx、mt_mp_ginv.xlsx  res$st_sp$summary res$mt_sp$param res_bt <- asr_scenarios(sc, ginv, scenarios = "mt_bt", fixed = ~ hhys,                         genetic_cov = "corgh", inbreeding = inbreeding) res_bt$mt_bt$param        # 各群体 h2、群体间 rg（含 SE）、rg_p

title: mintyrasr 入门
text: asr_gblup() 接收一张嵌套参数表和一张交叉验证表，二者通过共同的外层列（name、pairs、test_herd……）对应。 用 w2l_nest() / c2p_nest() + nest_cv() 自己生成的表也可以。响应列不叫 value / value1 + value2 时，用 traits 指定：
code: st <- asr_gblup(sc$st_sp$param, sc$st_sp$cv, ginv = ginv,                 fixed = ~ hhys, inbreeding = inbreeding,                 path = "results/st_sp_ginv.xlsx") st nested <- w2l_nest(pheno, cols = c("adg", "bf"), by = "test_herd", out_type = "df") cvtab  <- nest_cv(nested, v = 5, repeats = 2, seed = 1, out_type = "df") asr_gblup(nested, cvtab, ginv, fixed = ~ hhys)  asr_gblup(all_nest5, all_cv5, ginv, fixed = ~ hhys, traits = c("bfs", "nls"),           genetic_cov = "corgh", residual_cov = "diag", rp = FALSE)

title: mintyrasr 入门
text: 每个结果是一个列表，每个元素是工作簿中的一张表。 pa（预测能力）= 验证个体的 r(y, GEBV)； accuracy（准确性）= pa / sqrt(h2)，h2 用全数据估计值（Dekkers 2007）； slope = b(y ~ GEBV)，等于 1 表示 GEBV 既没有膨胀也没有压缩。 可靠性低于 min_rel（默认 0.05）的 GEBV 不参与计算；剩下的个体少于 min_n（默认 10）时，该折的 PA、准确性和回归系数为 NA；neg_to_na = TRUE（默认）时，负值在汇总前设为 NA。

id: 交叉验证中的方差组分
what: 6. 交叉验证中的方差组分
title: mintyrasr 入门
text: 计算可靠性用的 va 总是取当折模型的值。

title: mintyrasr 入门
text: 不保存模型对象，折数很多时内存也不会爆。 某次拟合失败时给出警告、结果为 NA，循环继续（on_error = "stop" 则立即停止）。max_update = 2 对未收敛的模型调用 update()。 两性状 GBLUP 需要比 ASReml 默认（maxit = 13、workspace = "128mb"）更大的设置；mintyrasr 默认 maxit = 100、workspace = "30Gb"。 na_x = "include"（默认，与常见脚本一致）把缺失协变量当作 0，数值协变量请先中心化；ASReml 自身默认是 "fail"。 其他 asreml() 参数：asreml_args = list(ai.sing = TRUE)。 下一步：模型与遗传参数——随机效应、方差结构、V 编号如何确定、检验以及自定义 vpredict() 公式。

title: Get started with mintyrasr
text: mintyr prepares data usual comparison genomic prediction models: every scenario nested table parameter estimation (records) table training / validation sets (one row per repeat x fold), validated individuals. mintyrasr takes tables , every row: fits model full data: variance components, h2 , two traits, rg, rp LRT rg = 0; refits every training set (variance components fixed, warm-started re-estimated); predicts GEBVs validation individuals computes reliability, predictive ability, accuracy slope; summarises folds writes one Excel workbook per scenario.

title: Get started with mintyrasr
code: # ASReml-R 4 must be installed and licensed first (https://vsni.co.uk/) install.packages("mintyr") pak::pak("tony2015116/mintyrasr")

title: Get started with mintyrasr
text: need three objects: phenotypes: one row per individual, ID, grouping column (herd, line, …), fixed effects traits; ginv: inverse genomic relationship matrix form vm() accepts. must carry attr(ginv, "INVERSE") <- TRUE, otherwise vm() treats G (mintyrasr warns); inbreeding (optional): data.frame (id, F) reliability 1 - PEV / ((1 + F) Va). GBLUP, F = diag(G) - 1 common. Without , F = 0 used.
code: library(asreml) library(ASRgenomics) library(mintyr) library(mintyrasr)  pheno <- import_xlsx("pheno.xlsx")             # id, test_herd, hhys, adg, bf, fcr  G    <- G.matrix(M = snp, method = "VanRaden")$G ginv <- G.inverse(G = G, sparseform = TRUE)$Ginv.sparse   # carries INVERSE = TRUE inbreeding <- data.frame(id = rownames(G), F = diag(G) - 1)

title: Get started with mintyrasr
code: sc <- cv_scenarios(pheno, cols = c("adg", "bf", "fcr"), id = "id",                    group = "test_herd", v = 5, repeats = 5, seed = 2026,                    out_type = "df")      # ASReml-R needs data.frames sc

title: Get started with mintyrasr
text: Add "mt_bt" scenarios one trait treated different trait two groups (G x E). fitted diag residual without rp, individual records groups:
code: res <- asr_scenarios(sc, ginv, fixed = ~ hhys, inbreeding = inbreeding,                      dir = "results") # results/st_sp_ginv.xlsx, st_mp_ginv.xlsx, mt_sp_ginv.xlsx, mt_mp_ginv.xlsx  res$st_sp$summary res$mt_sp$param res_bt <- asr_scenarios(sc, ginv, scenarios = "mt_bt", fixed = ~ hhys,                         genetic_cov = "corgh", inbreeding = inbreeding) res_bt$mt_bt$param        # h2 per group, rg between groups (+ SE), rg_p

title: Get started with mintyrasr
text: asr_gblup() takes nested parameter table CV table. matched shared outer columns (name, pairs, test_herd, …). Tables built hand w2l_nest() / c2p_nest() + nest_cv() work . response columns called value / value1 + value2, name traits:
code: st <- asr_gblup(sc$st_sp$param, sc$st_sp$cv, ginv = ginv,                 fixed = ~ hhys, inbreeding = inbreeding,                 path = "results/st_sp_ginv.xlsx") st nested <- w2l_nest(pheno, cols = c("adg", "bf"), by = "test_herd", out_type = "df") cvtab  <- nest_cv(nested, v = 5, repeats = 2, seed = 1, out_type = "df") asr_gblup(nested, cvtab, ginv, fixed = ~ hhys)  asr_gblup(all_nest5, all_cv5, ginv, fixed = ~ hhys, traits = c("bfs", "nls"),           genetic_cov = "corgh", residual_cov = "diag", rp = FALSE)

title: Get started with mintyrasr
text: result list; every element becomes one sheet workbook. pa (predictive ability) = r(y, GEBV) validation individuals; accuracy = pa / sqrt(h2), h2 full data (Dekkers 2007); slope = b(y ~ GEBV); 1 means inflation deflation GEBVs. GEBVs reliability min_rel (default 0.05) left ; fold needs least min_n (default 10) remaining individuals, otherwise PA, accuracy slope NA. neg_to_na = TRUE (default) negative values set NA summary.

title: Get started with mintyrasr
text: va used reliability always taken model fold.

title: Get started with mintyrasr
text: Fitted models kept: memory stays low even many folds. failing fit gives warning NA results; loop carries (on_error = "stop" stop instead). max_update = 2 calls update() fits converged. Two-trait GBLUP needs ASReml’s defaults (maxit = 13, workspace = "128mb"); mintyrasr uses maxit = 100, workspace = "30Gb". na_x = "include" (default, many scripts) treats missing covariates 0 - centre numeric covariates first. ASReml’s default "fail". asreml() arguments: asreml_args = list(ai.sing = TRUE). Next: Models genetic parameters - random effects, variance structures, V numbers found, tests vpredict() formulas.

title: 模型与遗传参数
text: 单性状（嵌套数据有 value 列，或 traits = "adg"）： 两性状（value1 + value2，或 traits = c("", "b")）： 常见写法：
code: asreml(value ~ <fixed>,        random   = ~ vm(id, ginv) + <random>,        residual = ~ idv(units), dense = ~ vm(id, ginv), ...) asreml(cbind(value1, value2) ~ trait + trait:<fixed>,        random   = ~ <genetic_cov>(trait):vm(id, ginv) + <random_cov>(trait):<random>,        residual = ~ units:<residual_cov>(trait), dense = ~ <genetic_cov>(trait):vm(id, ginv), ...) # 重复记录：加永久环境效应，否则高估 h2 asr_gblup(param, cv, ginv, fixed = ~ hhys, random = ~ ide(id))  # 窝效应，性状间不相关 asr_gblup(param, cv, ginv, fixed = ~ hhys, random = ~ litter, random_cov = "idh")  # us() 难收敛时用相关参数化 asr_gblup(param, cv, ginv, fixed = ~ hhys, genetic_cov = "corgh")  # 同一性状在两个场：没有个体同时有两个记录 -> diag 残差，不算 rp asr_gblup(param, cv, ginv, fixed = ~ hhys, traits = c("bfs", "nls"),           genetic_cov = "corgh", residual_cov = "diag", rp = FALSE)

what: 为什么不能写死 V1 / (V1 + V2)？
title: 模型与遗传参数
text: vpredict() 中的 V1、V2……按模型 vparameters 的顺序编号，这个顺序随模型变化： rg ~ V2 / sqrt(V1 * V3) 对第一个模型是对的；对第二个模型是错的（V1 已经是相关系数），带 V7 的 rp 公式还会报错。所以 mintyrasr 读取方差组分的名字，自动生成公式。

title: 模型与遗传参数
text: summary(fit)$varcomp 的每一行先和 names(fit$vparameters) 对应（得到 V 编号），再分类： 性状名在组分名中按完整单词匹配，任何列名都可以。结果中的 vc_index 表列出了分类，新模型第一次运行后请看一眼。

title: 模型与遗传参数
text: 对每个性状 ，Vp_i = 该性状所有方差之和（遗传 + 其他随机效应 + 残差）： h2_i = Va_i / Vp_i rg = Cov_a / sqrt(Va1 Va2)；corv / corh / corgh 时直接取相关参数 rp = 所有协方差之和 / sqrt(Vp1 Vp2)；相关参数化的项按 r sqrt(V1 V2) 换算成协方差 自动生成的例子（param$formulas）：
code: # 单性状，G + e h2 = V1/(V1 + V2) # 单性状，G + pe + e h2 = V1/(V1 + V2 + V3) # us G + us R h2_value1 = V1/(V1 + V5); rg = V2/sqrt(V1 * V3); rp = (V2 + V6)/sqrt((V1 + V5) * (V3 + V7)) # corgh G + diag R，同一性状在两个场 h2_nls = V2/(V2 + V5); h2_bfs = V3/(V3 + V6); rg = V1

title: 模型与遗传参数
text: 其他参数——重复力、窝效应比例、母体遗传力或总遗传力——用 vpredict 以命名列表给出。先在 vc_index 中确认 V 编号，它随模型变化。 有多个遗传项的模型（如母体效应的 str() 模型）以及 fa() / rr() 结构需要自己写公式：自动公式只使用 vm(<id>, ginv) 这一项。
code: res <- asr_gblup(param, cv, ginv, fixed = ~ hhys, random = ~ ide(id),                  vpredict = list(rep = rep ~ (V1 + V2) / (V1 + V2 + V3))) res$vc_index res$param[, c("h2", "h2_se", "rep", "rep_se")]

title: 模型与遗传参数
text: test_rp 检验的是两个性状是否有任何相关，不是单独对 rp = 0 的检验。结果在 param 的 rg_lrt、rg_p、cov_df、cov_lrt、cov_p 列。

title: 模型与遗传参数
text: ginv 没有 attr(, "INVERSE") = TRUE：vm() 会把它当作 G。 有表型的个体不在 ginv 中。 方差组分被固定在边界上（bound 为 B）：给出警告，并记在 param$boundary。 asreml.options(gammaPar = TRUE)：自动公式基于默认的方差（sigma）参数化。 模型未收敛（max_update 可调用 update()）。

title: Models and genetic parameters
text: Single trait (nested data value column, traits = "adg"): Two traits (value1 + value2, traits = c("", "b")): common choices:
code: asreml(value ~ <fixed>,        random   = ~ vm(id, ginv) + <random>,        residual = ~ idv(units), dense = ~ vm(id, ginv), ...) asreml(cbind(value1, value2) ~ trait + trait:<fixed>,        random   = ~ <genetic_cov>(trait):vm(id, ginv) + <random_cov>(trait):<random>,        residual = ~ units:<residual_cov>(trait), dense = ~ <genetic_cov>(trait):vm(id, ginv), ...) # repeated records: permanent environment, otherwise h2 is inflated asr_gblup(param, cv, ginv, fixed = ~ hhys, random = ~ ide(id))  # litter effect, uncorrelated between traits asr_gblup(param, cv, ginv, fixed = ~ hhys, random = ~ litter, random_cov = "idh")  # us() is hard to fit: correlation parameterisation asr_gblup(param, cv, ginv, fixed = ~ hhys, genetic_cov = "corgh")  # one trait in two herds: nobody has both records -> diag residual, no rp asr_gblup(param, cv, ginv, fixed = ~ hhys, traits = c("bfs", "nls"),           genetic_cov = "corgh", residual_cov = "diag", rp = FALSE)

title: Models and genetic parameters
text: vpredict() refers variance parameters V1, V2, … order vparameters component fit. order depends model: formula rg ~ V2 / sqrt(V1 * V3) right first model, wrong second (V1 already correlation) rp V7 fails. mintyrasr reads names components builds formulas .

title: Models and genetic parameters
text: row summary(fit)$varcomp matched names(fit$vparameters) (V number) classified: Trait names found whole words name, column name works. vc_index table result shows classification - look first run new model.

title: Models and genetic parameters
text: trait , Vp_i = sum used variances trait (genetic + random + residual): h2_i = Va_i / Vp_i rg = Cov_a / sqrt(Va1 Va2); corv / corh / corgh correlation parameter rp = (sum covariances) / sqrt(Vp1 Vp2); covariance correlation-parameterised term written r sqrt(V1 V2) Examples generated (param$formulas):
code: # single trait, G + e h2 = V1/(V1 + V2) # single trait, G + pe + e h2 = V1/(V1 + V2 + V3) # us G + us R h2_value1 = V1/(V1 + V5); rg = V2/sqrt(V1 * V3); rp = (V2 + V6)/sqrt((V1 + V5) * (V3 + V7)) # corgh G + diag R, one trait in two herds h2_nls = V2/(V2 + V5); h2_bfs = V3/(V3 + V6); rg = V1

title: Models and genetic parameters
text: Anything else - repeatability, litter proportion, maternal total heritability - goes vpredict, named list. Check V numbers vc_index first; depend model. Models one genetic term (e.g. maternal str() models) fa() / rr() structures need formulas: automatic ones use term vm(<id>, ginv).
code: res <- asr_gblup(param, cv, ginv, fixed = ~ hhys, random = ~ ide(id),                  vpredict = list(rep = rep ~ (V1 + V2) / (V1 + V2 + V3))) res$vc_index res$param[, c("h2", "h2_se", "rep", "rep_se")]

title: Models and genetic parameters
text: test_rp asks whether two traits correlated ; test rp = 0 . Results: rg_lrt, rg_p, cov_df, cov_lrt, cov_p param.

title: Models and genetic parameters
text: ginv without attr(, "INVERSE") = TRUE: vm() treat G. Individuals phenotypes ginv. Components fixed boundary (bound B): warning param$boundary. asreml.options(gammaPar = TRUE): automatic formulas assume default variance (sigma) parameterisation. Fits converge (max_update call update()).

what: 运行 全部场景或单个场景
text: 每个场景一个工作簿：<dir>/<场景>_<tag>.xlsx。"mt_bt"：diag 残差，不算 rp。
code: res <- asr_scenarios(sc, ginv, fixed = ~ hhys,                      inbreeding = inbreeding, dir = "results") st <- asr_gblup(sc$st_sp$param, sc$st_sp$cv, ginv,                 fixed = ~ hhys, path = "st_sp.xlsx") # 自己的嵌套表、其他列名 asr_gblup(all_nest, all_cv, ginv, fixed = ~ hhys,           traits = c("bfs", "nls"))

what: 模型 随机效应与方差结构
code: # 单性状：value ~ fixed，~ vm(id, ginv) + random，~ idv(units) # 两性状：cbind(a, b) ~ trait + trait:fixed， #   ~ genetic_cov(trait):vm(id, ginv) + random_cov(trait):random， #   ~ units:residual_cov(trait) asr_gblup(..., random = ~ ide(id))            # 重复记录 asr_gblup(..., random = ~ litter, random_cov = "idh") asr_gblup(..., genetic_cov = "corgh")         # us 难收敛时 asr_gblup(..., residual_cov = "diag", rp = FALSE)

what: 遗传参数 按组分名字定位
text: varcomp 每一行与 names(fit$vparameters)（即 vpredict 的 V）对应，并分为 遗传 / 随机 / 残差 和 方差 / 协方差 / 相关。尺度参数 units!R（在 units!units 之后）和 units:trait!R 不使用。
code: # us G + us R h2_value1 = V1/(V1 + V5); rg = V2/sqrt(V1 * V3) # corgh G + diag R h2_nls = V2/(V2 + V5); rg = V1 # 自定义公式（先看 res$vc_index） asr_gblup(..., random = ~ ide(id),   vpredict = list(rep = rep ~ (V1 + V2)/(V1 + V2 + V3)))

text: 警告：ginv 无 INVERSE 属性；个体不在 ginv 中；组分在边界上（B，也记在 param$boundary）；gammaPar = TRUE；未收敛 ASReml 默认 maxit = 13、workspace = "128mb"，两性状 GBLUP 不够用 max_update = 2 → 对未收敛模型调用 update() on_error = "warn"：某次拟合失败结果为 NA，循环继续 不保存模型对象 → 内存占用低 其他 asreml() 参数：asreml_args = list(ai.sing = TRUE)

code: pak::pak("tony2015116/mintyrasr")   # needs licensed ASReml-R 4 library(asreml); library(mintyr); library(mintyrasr)  ginv <- G.inverse(G, sparseform = TRUE)$Ginv.sparse inbreeding <- data.frame(id = rownames(G), F = diag(G) - 1)
sc <- cv_scenarios(pheno, cols = c("adg", "bf"), id = "id",                    group = "test_herd", v = 5, repeats = 5,                    seed = 2026, out_type = "df")

text: One workbook per scenario: <dir>/<scenario>_<tag>.xlsx. "mt_bt": diag residual, rp.
code: res <- asr_scenarios(sc, ginv, fixed = ~ hhys,                      inbreeding = inbreeding, dir = "results") st <- asr_gblup(sc$st_sp$param, sc$st_sp$cv, ginv,                 fixed = ~ hhys, path = "st_sp.xlsx") # own nested tables, other column names asr_gblup(all_nest, all_cv, ginv, fixed = ~ hhys,           traits = c("bfs", "nls"))

# 1 trait:  value ~ fixed,  ~ vm(id, ginv) + random,  ~ idv(units) # 2 traits: cbind(a, b) ~ trait + trait:fixed, #   ~ genetic_cov(trait):vm(id, ginv) + random_cov(trait):random, #   ~ units:residual_cov(trait) asr_gblup(..., random = ~ ide(id))            # repeated records asr_gblup(..., random = ~ litter, random_cov = "idh") asr_gblup(..., genetic_cov = "corgh")         # us too heavy asr_gblup(..., residual_cov = "diag", rp = FALSE)

text: varcomp row matched names(fit$vparameters) (= V vpredict) classified genetic / random / residual var / cov / cor. Scale rows units!R (units!units) units:trait!R skipped.

title: mintyrasr: mintyr GBLUP scenarios directly in ASReml-R
text: mintyrasr runs GBLUP parameter estimation cross-validation ASReml-R directly nested data built mintyr - input files exported. Four (five) scenarios one call: single-trait / two-trait x single group / groups combined, plus one trait different trait per group (mt_bt, G x E). Genetic parameters follow model: h2, rg rp built names variance components, fixed V1, V2, … positions, stay right add random effects (~ ide(id) + litter) change structures (us, idh, corv, corh, corgh). vc_index table shows V component. Correct tests: LRT rg = 0 idh(trait) boundary = FALSE; optional joint test covariances. Three ways treat variance components cross-validation: fixed full-data estimates (fast), warm-started, re-estimated per fold (leakage). Per fold: GEBV reliability 1 - PEV / ((1 + F) Va), predictive ability r(y, GEBV), accuracy PA / sqrt(h2), slope b(y ~ GEBV).
code: phenotypes ─► mintyr::cv_scenarios() ─► asr_scenarios() / asr_gblup() ─► varcomp · h2 · rg · rp · PA · accuracy · slope ─► xlsx

title: mintyrasr: mintyr GBLUP scenarios directly in ASReml-R
text: mintyrasr 直接在 mintyr 生成的嵌套数据上，用 ASReml-R 完成 GBLUP 参数估计和交叉验证，无需导出任何输入文件。 一次跑完所有场景：单性状 / 两性状 × 单群体 / 多群体，以及同一性状在不同群体当作不同性状（mt_bt，G×E）。 遗传参数跟着模型走：h2、rg、rp 按方差组分的名字自动生成 vpredict 公式，不再写死 V1、V2……； 加随机效应（~ ide(id) + litter）或换结构（us、idh、corv、corh、corgh）都不会算错，vc_index 表列出每个 V 对应的组分。 检验正确：rg = 0 用 idh(trait) 对照、boundary = FALSE；可选所有协方差的联合检验。 交叉验证中方差组分三种处理：固定为全数据估计值（快）、以全数据为初值重估、每折完全重估（无信息泄漏）。 每折输出：GEBV 可靠性 1 - PEV / ((1 + F) Va)、预测能力 r(y, GEBV)、准确性 PA / sqrt(h2)、回归系数 b(y ~ GEBV)。 入门 模型与遗传参数 速查表

title: GBLUP parameter estimation and cross-validation with ASReml-R — asr_gblup
text: asr_gblup() runs whole GBLUP workflow one scenario directly R, input files exported ASReml: fits model every data set param: variance components, heritability , two-trait models, genetic / phenotypic correlations plus LRT rg = 0 (idh(trait) vs full genetic structure, boundary = FALSE); refits model every training set cv, variance components handled set cv_vc; predicts GEBVs validation individuals, computes reliability 1 - PEV / ((1 + F) * Va), drops GEBVs reliability min_rel, returns per fold predictive ability pa = r(y, GEBV), accuracy pa / sqrt(h2) (h2 full data, Dekkers 2007) slope b(y ~ GEBV); summarises folds (n, mean, sd, se) , optionally, writes everything one Excel workbook. h2, rg rp built names variance components, fixed V positions, stay correct random effects added (random = ~ ide(id) + litter) covariance structures change (us, idh/diag, corh, corgh): h2 = Va / (variances trait), rg = Cov_a / sqrt(Va1 Va2) (correlation corh/corgh), rp = sum covariances / sqrt(Vp1 Vp2). vc_index table shows V component param$formulas formulas used. V numbers follow fit$vparameters, order vpredict() uses. Components fixed boundary (bound B) reported warning param$boundary. fa() / rr() terms models several genetic terms (e.g. maternal str() models) need formulas vpredict. Single-trait two-trait models chosen nested data: value column gives single-trait model, value1 + value2 two-trait model (layout mintyr::w2l_nest() / mintyr::c2p_nest()).

title: GBLUP parameter estimation and cross-validation with ASReml-R — asr_gblup
text: param Nested table used parameter estimation, list-column data (e.g. cv_scenarios(...)$st_sp$param). cv Cross-validation table list-columns train validate (e.g. cv_scenarios(...)$st_sp$cv output mintyr::nest_cv()). row matched row param shares outer columns. ginv Inverse genomic (pedigree) relationship matrix used vm(), e.g. G.inverse(G, sparseform = TRUE)$Ginv.sparse. must carry attr(, "INVERSE") = TRUE, otherwise vm() takes G (warning given). fixed One-sided formula fixed effects, e.g. ~ hhys. two-trait models every term nested trait (trait + trait:hhys). random Optional one-sided formula random effects, e.g. ~ ide(id) (permanent environment, repeated records), ~ litter + pen. two-trait models term gets structure random_cov. id Name individual ID column nested data. traits Optional response column(s), one two, nested data use value / value1 + value2, e.g. c("bfs", "nls") one trait recorded two herds (cv_scenarios(...)$mt_bt). genetic_cov, random_cov, residual_cov Two-trait models: variance structure across traits genomic term, extra random terms residual: "us", "idh", "diag", "corv", "corh" "corgh" (residual: "us", "idh", "diag"). cv_vc variance components handled fold: "fixed" (default, fast): fixed full-data estimates (Constraint = "F", maxit = 1; slight information leakage validation records used estimate ); "warm": re-estimated training set, starting full-data values; "estimate": re-estimated training set default start values (leakage, slowest). vpredict Optional named list extra vpredict() formulas, e.g. list(rep = rep ~ (V1 + V2) / (V1 + V2 + V3)). Check V numbers vc_index table first run: depend model. inbreeding Inbreeding coefficients: data.frame whose first column ID second column F, named numeric vector. NULL uses F = 0. GBLUP, F = diag(G) - 1 common. min_rel GEBVs reliability value set NA computing PA / accuracy. Use -Inf keep . min_n Minimum number validation individuals usable GEBV (min_rel) PA, accuracy slope fold; fewer gives NA (n still shows number). low h2 reliability filter can leave handful individuals, whose PA slope noise. neg_to_na Set negative PA / accuracy / slope NA summary (behaviour original scripts). test_rg Two-trait models : LRT rg = 0 (idh(trait) genetic structure, structures unchanged, boundary = FALSE). models end number free parameters (df = 0, e.g. restrained covariance), rg_p NA warning. test_rp Two-trait models : LRT covariances = 0 (idh genetic, extra random residual terms; df = number covariance / correlation parameters). tests whether traits correlated , rp = 0 . rp Compute phenotypic correlation. Set FALSE individual records traits (e.g. one trait two herds): residual covariance estimable rp meaningful. na_x na.method(x = ): "include" (default, original scripts) treats missing covariates / factor levels 0 design matrix - centre numeric covariates first; ASReml's default "fail". dense Put genomic term dense (faster GBLUP). maxit, workspace Passed asreml() (maxit 1 cv_vc = "fixed"). ASReml's defaults 13 "128mb"; two-trait GBLUP usually needs . max_update Number update() calls fit converged. asreml_args Named list asreml() arguments, e.g. list(ai.sing = TRUE). on_error "warn" (default): failing fit gives warning NA results, loop continues. "stop": stop first failure. keep_pred Return validation predictions (pred). path Optional .xlsx file write results . verbose Print progress.
